record.safety_margin_rule: Predeclared: watchdog_max >= 2 * measured population maximum; health_window >= watchdog_interval + 2 * measured maximum; measured maximum < watchdog_max. This empirical factor is not a confidence bound or production SLO.
record.credential_handling: Fresh seed-derived rehearsal-only ADMIN/four service passwords; private files only; no role/ACL/owner changes; erase private plaintext after measurement.

configuration.pool: PGSimpleDataSource; no recording/fake JDBC; persistent physical sessions within each warm/load population; new ADMIN and AUDITOR physical sessions per cold sample
configuration.network_path: Windows JVM -> dynamically rediscovered 127.0.0.1 mapped port -> Docker Desktop Linux PostgreSQL
configuration.load_scope: Actual Kotlin GovernedTransaction, four service identities; S02/S05/S07/S13 nonexistent-scope P0017 denials. This is representative transport/guard traffic, not positive full catalog/frozen-domain load.

findings.reason: Candidate watchdog maximum 20000 us is less than measured worst case 80684 us; predeclared 2x safety margin is also not met. Even warmed/idle maximum 47904 us independently exceeds the candidate maximum. This is a fixture/transport qualification gap, not evidence of SQL authorization failure.

clock_authority: Both heartbeat timestamp and observation clock are generated by the same PostgreSQL cluster; no subtraction of unrelated client clocks
